title: True/False, Matching and Comprehension Questions on As You Like It
summary: Students read extracts from As You Like It and complete three exercises: determining whether statements are true or false, matching characters with their descriptions, and answering comprehension questions about the plot.

title: Reordering Jacques' Speech and Writing a Letter as Duke Frederick
summary: Students rearrange lines from Jacques' speech about Duke Frederick's encounter with a religious man and his conversion, then write a creative letter from Duke Frederick to his brother explaining his decision to become a holy man.
